about: The tutorial's parts on the verified compiler: lessons whose code is Lean that runs in the page. The rest of the tutorial (Parts A-D) is in qccd/viz/js/tutorial.js.

parts.title: The machine as data
parts.about: Devices as graphs, programmes as data, replay as a function, and the rules as statements Lean can decide.

parts.title: Certificates and the proved checker
parts.about: What a certificate records, what it means for one to hold, the decision procedure that settles it, and the proof that the procedure is right.

lessons.title: Certificates: the Bell pair, proved
lessons.story: Take one real certificate from the Compilation page, watch it play, prove it holds, and prove three lies about it refused.

parts.title: Semantics: which gate the pulses make
parts.about: Exact numbers, the native pulses as matrices, u3 from two pulses, CX from one entangling pulse, stabilizer tableaux, and measurement -- without Mathlib.

parts.title: Verify the website yourself
parts.about: Every compiled case this site publishes, checked by you: in the page for the small ones, with the downloadable checker for the large ones.

parts.title: Build your own verified compiler
parts.about: A compiler for a chain of traps written in Lean and proved correct by construction; then a compiler in any language, validated by the checker; then the Compiler board.
